title: Algorithms to Live By
author: Brian Christian
summary: Brian Christian and Tom Griffiths show how computer science ideas such as optimal stopping, caching and sorting can inform everyday choices like when to stop looking for a flat or how to organize a desk.
readIf: you enjoy seeing everyday dilemmas through the lens of math and computing.
skipIf: you want firm rules to follow, since many of the answers are probabilities and trade-offs.
